Replies.Text:
Build log, Step 5: Guide, Pictures, Help and Smoke. Built as decided, with the notes below; CodeMirror is the default engine, the guide describes the one view with Monaco mode as the backup, the pictures are retaken, the smoke runs whole. Resolve to have it committed as "Markdown Editor: Step 5"; on "your turn" the parent plan gets its "What is built" record and is set Finished, as plan UI Components was closed. Nothing is pushed or published until you say so.

What was done

1. The default (decision 1): editor_setting() in app.js reads CodeMirror unless the look remembers Monaco; a browser with no remembered Editor, and a fresh install, open in the Live Preview. The browser tests, written for Monaco, set it once in their before hook (set_editor), and the CodeMirror tests switch on their own as before; the smoke and the documentation pictures start from CodeMirror now.
2. The guide (2): editing.md rewritten around the one view: the editor as the view and the heading's Source, Revisions, Save and Discard; what renders in place and what stays as written; the threads in the text (the highlights, the click, the card scrolling to the passage, the selection buttons and when Comment needs a save first); saving (the dot, the draft kept with the tab, the newer revision taken silently or the stale line with Discard, the stale save refused, read-only for archived plans and old revisions); closing with unsaved changes (the one prompt, Close others and Close all, the desktop and the browser, Confirm on close); Monaco mode as the backup; Revisions as a toggle; the tabs with the dot; the hotkeys table with the Ctrl+E and Ctrl+S rows as Step 3 changed them. threads.md: a thread's words in the pane scroll the text to its passage, Escape clears the selection (the click off a highlight in Monaco mode's Read view). getting-started.md and settings.md: the gear's fourth control, CodeMirror named first. readme.md: the stack line, Documents, the page paragraph, the Preview and Copy sentences. The html rebuilt (node bin/docs.js build, 8 pages).
3. The pictures (3): plan.png and comment.png now show the editor (the plan with its highlighted passages; the comment started from a selection made in the editor); edit.png is the Live Preview with the threads pane hidden and the cursor on the second heading, its source showing; source.png is new, Source mode with its gutters; revisions.png is retaken with Revisions as a toggle; tabs.png shows one tab with the dot; close-prompt.png is new, the prompt over that tab's ×, then Cancel and the draft forgotten before the pictures that follow; title-bar.png has the fourth control in the popover. 30 pictures written, both themes (node bin/docs.js screenshots --no-desktop; the desktop pictures stay as they were); docs.js's open_plan waits for the editor now, and PAGE_PICTURES and Docs.test.js list the two new names.
4. The help (4): the Hotkeys popup carries Step 3's rows; About unchanged.
5. The smoke (5): the page part starts from the editor (the two marks, the Live Preview, the one view, the bullets, the drag), takes page-light.png there, then switches to Monaco in the popover with the dark theme and checks the Read view's marks and Monaco's Edit (page-dark-monaco.png); the desktop part waits for the editor where it waited for the Read view. .guides/run-the-smoke.md rewritten for the checks as they stand, with the advice to run it alone. the whole smoke (page and desktop) ends SMOKE OK with 43 checks.
6. The records (6): the repository's README is updated above; the project's Readme, the parent's "What is built" and the states come with "your turn".
7. Tests: node --test: 196 pass (Docs.test.js checks the 30 pictures and the rebuilt pages; the browser tests run on Monaco as they were written, set once in their before hook).

Notes and departures

- edit.png shows a heading, two lists and three marks, not a code block: the documentation's demo plan (the shopping list) has none, and a code block in a shopping list would read wrong. The Live Preview's own test fixture holds every construct.
- The smoke's dark picture is Monaco mode now (page-dark-monaco.png), since the light one is the editor; the guide for the smoke says so.
- The look popover still has three selects, so the title bar test and the smoke's count hold; the checkbox is a fourth row.
- Nothing else of the code changed in this step.
